notices.trigger: Every home improvement contract (not new construction or a rebuild of all or substantially all of a single-family dwelling); handed over before the buyer signs, and again with a written addition to the job
notices.support: Fail to provide the buyer with a summary of these regulations, as prepared by the Consumer Protection Unit, as published on the Consumer Protection Unit website, prior to the buyer signing a home improvement contract
notices.summary_row: "A Summary of Your Rights as a Consumer in Home Improvement Transactions" (must be handed over before signing)
notices.block: 2. Attorney General's Summary (the document to hand over), complete, both pages

notices.format: Statement in bold type of at least 10 point in immediate proximity to the buyer's signature space, in an ink color different from the rest of the contract; ends with the sentence about the attached notice form; the contract in the language of the sales talk; oral notice also required (the duplicate form is the separate notice DE-cancel-form)
notices.support: shall be printed in an ink of a conspicuous color other than that used for the rest of the contract and/or receipt
notices.summary_row: Door-to-door statement, Notice of Cancellation form, oral notice, definitions
notices.block: 4. 6 Del. C. 4403 and 4404 (Home Solicitation Sales Act: definitions, statement, Notice of Cancellation)
notices.title: State cancellation statement near the signature (door-to-door sale)
notices.start: YOU, THE BUYER, MAY CANCEL THIS TRANSACTION
notices.end: FOR AN EXPLANATION OF THIS RIGHT.
notices.quote_note: The statute's opening and closing curly quotation marks around the statement are excluded by placing the markers inside them. The closing mark follows the final period, which is inside the cut.
notices.boundary_unsure: None on the edges: the statement is a single quoted paragraph introduced by 'in substantially the following form:'. Note the statute also requires it in a conspicuous ink color different from the rest of the contract; that is formatting, not wording.

notices.title: Duplicate NOTICE OF CANCELLATION form (door-to-door sale)
notices.trigger: Door-to-door sale or a sale made away from the seller's place of business, $25 or more
notices.format: Form in duplicate, attached to the contract and easily detachable, in 10 point bold type, in the same language as the contract; seller completes name, address and last cancellation date on both copies before handing them over
notices.support: a completed form in duplicate, captioned “Notice of Cancellation,” which shall be attached to the contract or receipt and easily detachable, and which shall contain in 10-point, bold-faced type the following information and statements in the same language
notices.summary_row: Door-to-door statement, Notice of Cancellation form, oral notice, definitions
notices.block: 4. 6 Del. C. 4403 and 4404 (Home Solicitation Sales Act: definitions, statement, Notice of Cancellation)
notices.quote_note: The statute's opening curly quotation mark before NOTICE OF CANCELLATION and the closing curly mark after (Buyer’s signature) are excluded by placing the markers inside them. Blank lines inside the form are the official page layout and stay. The start marker repeats (the capitals also appear in the statement in 4404(1)), so the second occurrence is used.
notices.boundary_unsure: None on the edges. The odd line break before ', at' is as the official page prints it.

changes.support: SATURDAY DOES NOT COUNT in Delaware
Fail to inform each buyer orally, at the time the buyer signs the contract or purchases the goods or services, of the right to cancel.

changes.new: Three business days (Saturday does not count), duplicate form, $25 or more; no age 62 extension exists
changes.support: Age 62 five-day extension. Not in the Home Solicitation Sales Act.

changes.new: Saturday, Sunday and legal holidays are not business days, so the Delaware deadline can fall later than the federal one; print the later date. No senior extension exists in chapter 44.
changes.support: so the Delaware deadline can fall later than the federal one; print the later date.
Delaware HAS a statute (the first pass found none): 6 Del. C. 2731 to 2737, in force January 1, 2022.

new.rule: Disclose the renewal terms clearly at signing and notify 30 to 60 days before the cancellation deadline when a renewal of more than 1 month would keep the contract in effect over 12 months; any auto-renewing contract needs an easy cancellation mechanism, online if signed online
new.scope_and_confidence: PRIMARY; month-to-month cleaning is outside 2734 but inside 2732(4); contracts over $50,000 are outside the subchapter (2736)

changes.support: Month-to-month cleaning is outside 2734 but inside 2732(4). Contracts over $50,000 are outside the subchapter (2736).

unsure: DE-ag-summary: the text is stored on file only, because the AG requires the official letterhead and layout and the stored block is a text layer of the PDF; the official PDF itself should be attached.
DE written additions: the AG FAQ says a written addition must be accompanied by a copy of the summary, which the builder cannot detect.

DE-cancel: the statement and the form are now two notices (DE-cancel and DE-cancel-form), each cut by markers; both print only for sold_in_home jobs, which only approximates 'a place other than the place of business of the seller'.

DE-cancel-form: the seller must fill in the name, address and the last cancellation date (not earlier than the third business day) on both copies before handing them over (4404(3)); the builder prints the blanks as they appear.
